create_ethos_dataset: create an Ethos classification dataset for a given dimension like violence or gender
run_ethos_preprocessing: run the main function to generate k-shot data for all seven ETHOS dimensions
load_ethos_multilabel: load the ETHOS multilabel dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
map_hf_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
split_train_test: split the ETHOS training data into 80/20 train and test line sets
